parsed_json.up: Define the compound set starting from CHEMBL941 in molecule_dictionary, include the parent row and all related salts by joining molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno. Retrieve activity provenance through the FAQ path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter to standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM', and target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1936'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by all returned columns in listed order. No row limit.
